note: The script asks for three graphics: the question on frame 1, the full question it grows into at 00:07, and the Comment “I'm in” ask text. The other rows are captions only, and the logo is only on the end card.

mg.title: Commit question
mg.cue: Frame 1: only “WHAT WILL YOU COMMIT TO?”, big, top half. Cut on
mg.use: Put it big in the top half of the white frame. The script says cut on, so start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:07.

mg.title: Full commit question

text.main: WHAT WILL YOU COMMIT TO DOING ABOUT HOMELESSNESS — AND WHEN?

mg.cue: On “when”, the text grows into the full question: “WHAT WILL YOU COMMIT TO DOING ABOUT HOMELESSNESS — AND WHEN?”
mg.use: It replaces the short question on “when” at 00:07 and stays up to the ask at 00:29. The clip is 10 seconds, so hold its last frame until 00:29. The template cannot colour only “WHEN?” in gold.

mg.title: Comment I'm in
mg.cue: Ask text on screen: Comment “I'm in”. Big, center, on the word “comment”. Holds to the end card
mg.use: Big, in the center, on the word “comment” at 00:29. The question text goes off here. Hold it until the end card at 00:33.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Logo swishes in (about 10 frames), settles, holds. Same animation on all 12 videos. Make it once, reuse it. Nothing under the logo.
mg.src: The Journey Home logo from the client's own slides in Dwayne's Day 2 pm.mov (uploaded 6 Oct 2026), as the script asks.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 00:33 after the last line and hold it to the end.
